# ChartOrientation

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Controls the orientation of a Cartesian chart.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Vertical`: Categories run along the X-axis (bottom) and values along the Y-axis (left). Default.
- `Horizontal`: Categories run along the Y-axis (left) and values along the X-axis (bottom). Bars, stems, and filled areas extend horizontally from the left axis baseline.
